title: On Sampling Lower Bounds for Polynomials
summary: In this work, we continue the line of research on the complexity of distributions (Viola, Journal of Computing 2012), and study samplers defined by low degree polynomials. An $n$-tuple $P = (P_1,\dots, P_n)$ of functions $P_i \colon \mathbb{F}_2^m \to \mathbb{F}_2$ defines a distribution over $\{0,1\}^n$ in the natural way: draw $X$ uniformly at random from $\mathbb{F}_2^m$ and output $(P_1(X),\dots, P_n(X)) \in \{0,1\}^n$.
